statements:
-- Create order status enum
CREATE TYPE public.order_status AS ENUM (
  'draft',
  'submitted',
  'under_review',
  'waiting_for_approval',
  'approved_by_customer',
  'rejected_by_customer',
  'waiting_for_payment',
  'in_production',
  'completed',
  'cancelled'
);

-- Create app role enum
CREATE TYPE public.app_role AS ENUM ('admin', 'customer');

-- Profiles table
CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  phone TEXT DEFAULT '',
  company_name TEXT DEFAULT '',
  billing_address TEXT DEFAULT '',
  shipping_address TEXT DEFAULT '',
  postal_code TEXT DEFAULT '',
  city TEXT DEFAULT '',
  country TEXT DEFAULT 'Nederland',
  vat_number TEXT DEFAULT '',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- User roles table
CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
  role app_role NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (user_id, role)
);

-- Orders table
CREATE TABLE public.orders (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  order_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  customer_email TEXT NOT NULL,
  customer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  phone TEXT DEFAULT '',
  company_name TEXT DEFAULT '',
  billing_address TEXT DEFAULT '',
  shipping_address TEXT DEFAULT '',
  postal_code TEXT DEFAULT '',
  city TEXT DEFAULT '',
  country TEXT DEFAULT 'Nederland',
  vat_number TEXT DEFAULT '',
  material TEXT DEFAULT '',
  color TEXT DEFAULT '',
  quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  notes TEXT DEFAULT '',
  print_preferences TEXT DEFAULT '',
  instant_quote_price NUMERIC(10,2),
  final_price NUMERIC(10,2),
  tikkie_link TEXT,
  status order_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted',
  customer_order_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT encode(gen_random_bytes(32), 'hex'),
  customer_visible_notes TEXT DEFAULT '',
  internal_notes TEXT DEFAULT '',
  submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  rejected_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Order files table
CREATE TABLE public.order_files (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  order_id UUID REFERENCES public.orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
  storage_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_size BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
  mime_type TEXT DEFAULT '',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Order events table
CREATE TABLE public.order_events (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  order_id UUID REFERENCES public.orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_description TEXT DEFAULT '',
  performed_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  visible_to_customer BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Security definer function for role checking
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id UUID, _role app_role)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = _user_id
      AND role = _role
  )
$$;

-- Auto-create profile on signup
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, email, full_name)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    COALESCE(NEW.email, ''),
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', '')
  );
  INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES (NEW.id, 'customer');
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created
  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();

-- Auto-update updated_at
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER update_profiles_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.profiles
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at();

CREATE TRIGGER update_orders_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.orders
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at();

-- Generate order number function
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_order_number()
RETURNS TEXT
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
  new_number TEXT;
  counter INTEGER;
BEGIN
  SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 INTO counter FROM public.orders;
  new_number := 'OW3D-' || LPAD(counter::TEXT, 5, '0');
  RETURN new_number;
END;
$$;

-- Enable RLS
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.user_roles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.orders ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.order_files ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.order_events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Profiles RLS
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own profile" ON public.profiles
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE POLICY "Users can update own profile" ON public.profiles
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE POLICY "Admins can view all profiles" ON public.profiles
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'));

-- User roles RLS
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own roles" ON public.user_roles
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage roles" ON public.user_roles
  FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'));

-- Orders RLS
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own orders" ON public.orders
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE POLICY "Users can insert orders" ON public.orders
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE POLICY "Admins can do everything with orders" ON public.orders
  FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'));

-- Order files RLS
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own order files" ON public.order_files
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.orders WHERE orders.id = order_files.order_id AND orders.user_id = auth.uid()));

CREATE POLICY "Users can insert order files" ON public.order_files
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.orders WHERE orders.id = order_files.order_id AND orders.user_id = auth.uid()));

CREATE POLICY "Admins can do everything with order files" ON public.order_files
  FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'));

-- Order events RLS
CREATE POLICY "Users can view visible events" ON public.order_events
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    visible_to_customer = true AND
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.orders WHERE orders.id = order_events.order_id AND orders.user_id = auth.uid())
  );

CREATE POLICY "Admins can do everything with events" ON public.order_events
  FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'));

-- Storage bucket for order files
INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public) VALUES ('orders', 'orders', false);

-- Storage RLS policies
CREATE POLICY "Authenticated users can upload order files" ON storage.objects
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'orders');

CREATE POLICY "Authenticated users can view order files" ON storage.objects
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (bucket_id = 'orders');

CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage all storage" ON storage.objects
  FOR DELETE TO authenticated
  USING (bucket_id = 'orders' AND public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'));

-- Allow anonymous (guest) users to insert orders with null user_id
CREATE POLICY "Anon users can insert orders"
ON public.orders FOR INSERT
TO anon
WITH CHECK (user_id IS NULL);

-- Allow anonymous users to view their order by token (for redirect after submit)
CREATE POLICY "Anon users can view orders by token"
ON public.orders FOR SELECT
TO anon
USING (true);

-- Allow anonymous users to insert order_files for orders they just created
CREATE POLICY "Anon users can insert order files"
ON public.order_files FOR INSERT
TO anon
WITH CHECK (true);

-- Allow anonymous users to upload files to storage
CREATE POLICY "Anon users can upload order files"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT
TO anon
WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'orders');

-- Drop overly permissive policies and replace with scoped ones
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Anon users can view orders by token" ON public.orders;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Anon users can insert order files" ON public.order_files;

-- Anon can only SELECT orders (the edge function handles token-based access with service role)
-- No need for anon SELECT on orders - the edge function get-order-by-token handles this

-- Anon can insert order_files only for orders with null user_id (guest orders)
CREATE POLICY "Anon users can insert order files"
ON public.order_files FOR INSERT
TO anon
WITH CHECK (EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public.orders 
  WHERE orders.id = order_files.order_id 
  AND orders.user_id IS NULL
));
ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD COLUMN completed_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL;
ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD COLUMN saved boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;
ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS file_links text DEFAULT '';
ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD COLUMN order_method text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'file';

-- Allow anonymous uploads to orders bucket for custom order photos
CREATE POLICY "Anon users can upload to orders bucket"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT
TO anon
WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'orders');

-- Create blog_posts table
CREATE TABLE public.blog_posts (
  id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  excerpt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  meta_description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  featured_image_url TEXT,
  tags TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),
  author_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Overweel3D',
  published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Enable RLS
ALTER TABLE public.blog_posts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Anyone can read published posts
CREATE POLICY "Anyone can read published blog posts"
ON public.blog_posts
FOR SELECT
USING (status = 'published');

-- Admins can do everything
CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage all blog posts"
ON public.blog_posts
FOR ALL
TO authenticated
USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role));

-- Auto-update updated_at
CREATE TRIGGER update_blog_posts_updated_at
BEFORE UPDATE ON public.blog_posts
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at();

-- Index for slug lookups
CREATE INDEX idx_blog_posts_slug ON public.blog_posts(slug);
-- Index for listing published posts
CREATE INDEX idx_blog_posts_published ON public.blog_posts(status, published_at DESC);

-- 1. Order Messages (Chat)
CREATE TABLE public.order_messages (
  id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sender_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (sender_type IN ('customer', 'admin')),
  sender_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  read BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.order_messages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage all messages"
ON public.order_messages
FOR ALL
TO authenticated
USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role));

CREATE POLICY "Customers can view messages on their orders"
ON public.order_messages
FOR SELECT
TO authenticated
USING (EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public.orders
  WHERE orders.id = order_messages.order_id
  AND orders.user_id = auth.uid()
));

CREATE POLICY "Customers can send messages on their orders"
ON public.order_messages
FOR INSERT
TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  sender_type = 'customer'
  AND sender_id = auth.uid()
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.orders
    WHERE orders.id = order_messages.order_id
    AND orders.user_id = auth.uid()
  )
);

CREATE INDEX idx_order_messages_order ON public.order_messages(order_id, created_at);

-- 2. Plate tracking columns on orders
ALTER TABLE public.orders
ADD COLUMN parts_total INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
ADD COLUMN parts_per_plate INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
ADD COLUMN plates_completed INTEGER DEFAULT 0;

-- 3. Delivery Appointments
CREATE TABLE public.delivery_appointments (
  id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  proposed_date DATE NOT NULL,
  proposed_time_slot TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'cancelled')),
  proposed_by TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (proposed_by IN ('customer', 'admin')),
  customer_notes TEXT DEFAULT '',
  admin_notes TEXT DEFAULT '',
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.delivery_appointments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage all appointments"
ON public.delivery_appointments
FOR ALL
TO authenticated
USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role));

CREATE POLICY "Customers can view their order appointments"
ON public.delivery_appointments
FOR SELECT
TO authenticated
USING (EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public.orders
  WHERE orders.id = delivery_appointments.order_id
  AND orders.user_id = auth.uid()
));

CREATE POLICY "Customers can propose appointments"
ON public.delivery_appointments
FOR INSERT
TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  proposed_by = 'customer'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.orders
    WHERE orders.id = delivery_appointments.order_id
    AND orders.user_id = auth.uid()
  )
);

CREATE POLICY "Customers can update their pending appointments"
ON public.delivery_appointments
FOR UPDATE
TO authenticated
USING (
  proposed_by = 'customer'
  AND status = 'pending'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.orders
    WHERE orders.id = delivery_appointments.order_id
    AND orders.user_id = auth.uid()
  )
);

CREATE TRIGGER update_delivery_appointments_updated_at
BEFORE UPDATE ON public.delivery_appointments
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at();

CREATE INDEX idx_delivery_appointments_order ON public.delivery_appointments(order_id);

-- 4. Add delivery_email field to orders for admin-created orders
ALTER TABLE public.orders
ADD COLUMN delivery_email TEXT DEFAULT '';

statements:
-- Canonical newsletter subscriptions table.
-- The earlier newsletter_subscribers table is left intact so existing data is
-- never removed. Its rows are copied once into this table below.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.newsletter_subscriptions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email text NOT NULL,
  source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'website',
  active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  subscribed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  unsubscribed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT newsletter_subscriptions_email_length
    CHECK (char_length(email) BETWEEN 3 AND 254),
  CONSTRAINT newsletter_subscriptions_source_length
    CHECK (char_length(source) BETWEEN 1 AND 50),
  CONSTRAINT newsletter_subscriptions_source_allowed
    CHECK (source IN ('popup', 'footer', 'website')),
  CONSTRAINT newsletter_subscriptions_unsubscribe_state
    CHECK (
      (active AND unsubscribed_at IS NULL)
      OR (NOT active AND unsubscribed_at IS NOT NULL)
    )
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS newsletter_subscriptions_email_unique
  ON public.newsletter_subscriptions (lower(email));

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS newsletter_subscriptions_active_subscribed_at_idx
  ON public.newsletter_subscriptions (subscribed_at DESC)
  WHERE active;

ALTER TABLE public.newsletter_subscriptions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.newsletter_subscriptions FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.newsletter_subscriptions TO authenticated;
GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.newsletter_subscriptions TO service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can view newsletter subscriptions" ON public.newsletter_subscriptions;
CREATE POLICY "Admins can view newsletter subscriptions"
  ON public.newsletter_subscriptions
  FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::public.app_role));

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can update newsletter subscriptions" ON public.newsletter_subscriptions;
CREATE POLICY "Admins can update newsletter subscriptions"
  ON public.newsletter_subscriptions
  FOR UPDATE
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::public.app_role))
  WITH CHECK (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::public.app_role));

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can delete newsletter subscriptions" ON public.newsletter_subscriptions;
CREATE POLICY "Admins can delete newsletter subscriptions"
  ON public.newsletter_subscriptions
  FOR DELETE
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::public.app_role));

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_newsletter_subscriptions_updated_at ON public.newsletter_subscriptions;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_newsletter_subscriptions_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.newsletter_subscriptions
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.subscribe_to_newsletter(
  _email text,
  _source text DEFAULT 'website'
)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  normalized_email text := lower(btrim(_email));
  normalized_source text := lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(_source), ''), 'website'));
BEGIN
  IF normalized_email IS NULL
    OR char_length(normalized_email) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 254
    OR normalized_email !~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+\.[^[:space:]@]+$'
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ongeldig e-mailadres' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF normalized_source NOT IN ('popup', 'footer', 'website') THEN
    normalized_source := 'website';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.newsletter_subscriptions (
    email,
    source,
    active,
    subscribed_at,
    unsubscribed_at
  )
  VALUES (
    normalized_email,
    normalized_source,
    true,
    now(),
    NULL
  )
  ON CONFLICT ((lower(email))) DO UPDATE
  SET
    active = true,
    unsubscribed_at = NULL,
    subscribed_at = CASE
      WHEN public.newsletter_subscriptions.active THEN public.newsletter_subscriptions.subscribed_at
      ELSE now()
    END,
    source = CASE
      WHEN public.newsletter_subscriptions.active THEN public.newsletter_subscriptions.source
      ELSE EXCLUDED.source
    END;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.subscribe_to_newsletter(text, text) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.subscribe_to_newsletter(text, text) TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('public.newsletter_subscribers') IS NOT NULL THEN
    EXECUTE $copy$
      WITH normalized AS (
        SELECT
          lower(btrim(email)) AS normalized_email,
          CASE lower(btrim(source))
            WHEN 'popup' THEN 'popup'
            WHEN 'footer' THEN 'footer'
            WHEN 'website' THEN 'website'
            ELSE 'website'
          END AS normalized_source,
          active,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        FROM public.newsletter_subscribers
        WHERE email IS NOT NULL
          AND char_length(lower(btrim(email))) BETWEEN 3 AND 254
          AND lower(btrim(email)) ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+\.[^[:space:]@]+$'
      ),
      aggregated AS (
        SELECT
          normalized_email,
          (array_agg(normalized_source ORDER BY active DESC, created_at ASC, normalized_source ASC))[1]
            AS normalized_source,
          bool_or(active) AS active,
          coalesce(min(created_at) FILTER (WHERE active), min(created_at)) AS subscribed_at,
          min(created_at) AS created_at,
          max(updated_at) AS updated_at
        FROM normalized
        GROUP BY normalized_email
      )
      INSERT INTO public.newsletter_subscriptions AS destination (
        email,
        source,
        active,
        subscribed_at,
        unsubscribed_at,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      )
      SELECT
        normalized_email,
        normalized_source,
        active,
        subscribed_at,
        CASE WHEN active THEN NULL ELSE updated_at END,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      FROM aggregated
      ON CONFLICT ((lower(email))) DO UPDATE
      SET
        active = destination.active OR EXCLUDED.active,
        unsubscribed_at = CASE
          WHEN destination.active OR EXCLUDED.active THEN NULL
          ELSE greatest(destination.unsubscribed_at, EXCLUDED.unsubscribed_at)
        END,
        subscribed_at = CASE
          WHEN destination.active AND EXCLUDED.active
            THEN least(destination.subscribed_at, EXCLUDED.subscribed_at)
          WHEN destination.active THEN destination.subscribed_at
          WHEN EXCLUDED.active THEN EXCLUDED.subscribed_at
          ELSE least(destination.subscribed_at, EXCLUDED.subscribed_at)
        END,
        source = CASE
          WHEN destination.active THEN destination.source
          WHEN EXCLUDED.active THEN EXCLUDED.source
          ELSE destination.source
        END,
        created_at = least(destination.created_at, EXCLUDED.created_at)
    $copy$;

    EXECUTE 'REVOKE INSERT ON TABLE public.newsletter_subscribers FROM anon, authenticated';
    EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Anyone can subscribe" ON public.newsletter_subscribers';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

rows.name: order_tracking_and_plates
statements:
ALTER TABLE public.orders
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS link_first_viewed_at timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS link_last_viewed_at timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS link_view_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_plates integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_products integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS plate_print_statuses jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS confirmation_email_claimed_at timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS confirmation_email_sent_at timestamptz;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Anon users can view orders by token" ON public.orders;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Anon users can insert orders" ON public.orders;

UPDATE public.orders
SET total_products = GREATEST(COALESCE(parts_total, 0), COALESCE(quantity, 0), 0)
WHERE total_products = 0;

UPDATE public.orders
SET total_plates = GREATEST(
  COALESCE(plates_completed, 0),
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(parts_total, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(parts_per_plate, 0) > 0
      THEN CEIL(parts_total::numeric / parts_per_plate)::integer
    ELSE 0
  END,
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(plate_runs_completed) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(plate_runs_completed) ELSE 0 END,
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(plate_runs_required_per_plate) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(plate_runs_required_per_plate) ELSE 0 END,
  0
)
WHERE total_plates = 0;

UPDATE public.orders AS o
SET plate_print_statuses = COALESCE(
  (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      CASE
        WHEN plate_index < COALESCE(o.plates_completed, 0) THEN true
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(o.plate_runs_completed) = 'array'
          AND COALESCE(
            CASE
              WHEN (o.plate_runs_completed ->> plate_index) ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                AND char_length(o.plate_runs_completed ->> plate_index) <= 9
                THEN (o.plate_runs_completed ->> plate_index)::integer
              ELSE 0
            END, 0
          ) >= GREATEST(
            COALESCE(
              CASE
                WHEN jsonb_typeof(o.plate_runs_required_per_plate) = 'array'
                  AND (o.plate_runs_required_per_plate ->> plate_index) ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                  AND char_length(o.plate_runs_required_per_plate ->> plate_index) <= 9
                  THEN (o.plate_runs_required_per_plate ->> plate_index)::integer
                ELSE NULL
              END,
              NULLIF(o.plate_runs_required, 0),
              1
            ), 1
          )
        THEN true
        ELSE false
      END ORDER BY plate_index
    )
    FROM generate_series(0, o.total_plates - 1) AS generated(plate_index)
  ), '[]'::jsonb
)
WHERE o.total_plates > 0
  AND (o.plate_print_statuses IS NULL OR o.plate_print_statuses = '[]'::jsonb);

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname = 'orders_link_view_count_nonnegative' AND conrelid = 'public.orders'::regclass
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_link_view_count_nonnegative CHECK (link_view_count >= 0);
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname = 'orders_total_plates_nonnegative' AND conrelid = 'public.orders'::regclass
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_total_plates_nonnegative CHECK (total_plates >= 0);
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname = 'orders_total_products_nonnegative' AND conrelid = 'public.orders'::regclass
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_total_products_nonnegative CHECK (total_products >= 0);
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname = 'orders_plate_print_statuses_array' AND conrelid = 'public.orders'::regclass
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_plate_print_statuses_array
      CHECK (jsonb_typeof(plate_print_statuses) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(plate_print_statuses) = total_plates);
  END IF;
END
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_order_link_visit(p_token text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE updated_id uuid;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.orders
  SET link_first_viewed_at = COALESCE(link_first_viewed_at, clock_timestamp()),
      link_last_viewed_at = clock_timestamp(),

$$;

RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE claimed_id uuid;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.orders
  SET confirmation_email_claimed_at = clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id = p_order_id
    AND confirmation_email_sent_at IS NULL
    AND (confirmation_email_claimed_at IS NULL OR confirmation_email_claimed_at < clock_timestamp() - interval '15 minutes')
  RETURNING id INTO claimed_id;

END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_guest_order(p_order jsonb)
RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, customer_order_token text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE created_id uuid; created_token text;
BEGIN
  IF p_order IS NULL
    OR jsonb_typeof(p_order) <> 'object'
    OR octet_length(p_order::text) > 200000
    OR COALESCE(BTRIM(p_order ->> 'customer_name'), '') = ''
    OR char_length(BTRIM(p_order ->> 'customer_name')) > 200
    OR COALESCE(BTRIM(p_order ->> 'customer_email'), '') !~* '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+\.[^[:space:]@]+$'
    OR char_length(BTRIM(p_order ->> 'customer_email')) > 254
    OR COALESCE(BTRIM(p_order ->> 'order_number'), '') !~ '^OW3D-[0-9]+$'
    OR char_length(p_order ->> 'order_number') > 40
    OR COALESCE(p_order ->> 'quantity', '') !~ '^[0-9]{1,7}$'
    OR COALESCE(p_order ->> 'instant_quote_price', '') !~ '^[0-9]{1,9}([.][0-9]{1,4})?$'
    OR COALESCE(p_order ->> 'order_method', 'file') NOT IN ('file', 'link', 'prebuilt', 'custom', 'mixed')
    OR char_length(COALESCE(p_order ->> 'phone', '')) > 100
    OR char_length(COALESCE(p_order ->> 'company_name', '')) > 200
    OR char_length(COALESCE(p_order ->> 'billing_address', '')) > 500
    OR char_length(COALESCE(p_order ->> 'shipping_address', '')) > 500
    OR char_length(COALESCE(p_order ->> 'notes', '')) > 10000
    OR char_length(COALESCE(p_order ->> 'file_links', '')) > 100000
    OR (p_order ? 'catalog_items' AND (
      jsonb_typeof(p_order -> 'catalog_items') <> 'array'
      OR octet_length((p_order -> 'catalog_items')::text) > 100000
    ))
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid guest order data';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.orders AS created_order (
    order_number,user_id,customer_email,customer_name,phone,company_name,billing_address,
    shipping_address,postal_code,city,country,material,color,quantity,notes,print_preferences,
    instant_quote_price,file_links,order_method,status
  ) VALUES (
    p_order ->> 'order_number',NULL,BTRIM(p_order ->> 'customer_email'),BTRIM(p_order ->> 'customer_name'),
    COALESCE(p_order ->> 'phone', ''),COALESCE(p_order ->> 'company_name', ''),
    COALESCE(p_order ->> 'billing_address', ''),COALESCE(p_order ->> 'shipping_address', p_order ->> 'billing_address', ''),
    COALESCE(p_order ->> 'postal_code', ''),COALESCE(p_order ->> 'city', ''),COALESCE(p_order ->> 'country', 'Nederland'),
    COALESCE(p_order ->> 'material', ''),COALESCE(p_order ->> 'color', ''),
    GREATEST(COALESCE((p_order ->> 'quantity')::integer, 1), 0),COALESCE(p_order ->> 'notes', ''),
    COALESCE(p_order ->> 'print_preferences', ''),GREATEST(COALESCE((p_order ->> 'instant_quote_price')::numeric, 0), 0),
    COALESCE(p_order ->> 'file_links', ''),COALESCE(p_order ->> 'order_method', 'file'),'submitted'::public.order_status
  )
  RETURNING created_order.id, created_order.customer_order_token INTO created_id, created_token;

  IF p_order ? 'catalog_items'
    AND jsonb_typeof(p_order -> 'catalog_items') = 'array'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' AND column_name = 'catalog_items'
    )
  THEN
    EXECUTE 'UPDATE public.orders SET catalog_items = $1 WHERE id = $2'
      USING p_order -> 'catalog_items', created_id;
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT created_id, created_token;
END;
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.create_guest_order(jsonb) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.create_guest_order(jsonb) TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- Bambu Lab filament palette transcribed from the supplied inventory screenshot.
-- Physical duplicate spools are represented by one catalogue color; remaining
-- spool weight is deliberately not stored because filament_colors is a palette,
-- not a spool-inventory table.
INSERT INTO public.filament_colors (
  name,
  material,
  hex,
  description,
  sort_order,
  active
)
SELECT
  seed.name,
  seed.material,
  seed.hex,
  seed.description,
  seed.sort_order,
  true
FROM (VALUES
  ('Zwart', 'PLA', '#000000', 'Bambu Lab PLA Basic · 1,75 mm · artikelcode 10101', 10),
  ('Jadewit', 'PLA', '#FFFFFF', 'Bambu Lab PLA Basic · 1,75 mm · artikelcode 10100', 20),
  ('Blauw', 'PLA', '#0A2989', 'Bambu Lab PLA Basic · 1,75 mm · artikelcode 10601', 30),
  ('Zonnebloemgeel', 'PLA', '#FEC600', 'Bambu Lab PLA Basic · 1,75 mm · artikelcode 10402', 40),
  ('Bamboegroen', 'PLA', '#00AE42', 'Bambu Lab PLA Basic · 1,75 mm · artikelcode 10501', 50),
  ('Blauwgrijs', 'PLA', '#5B6579', 'Bambu Lab PLA Basic · 1,75 mm · artikelcode 10602', 60),
  ('Pompoenoranje', 'PLA', '#FF9016', 'Bambu Lab PLA Basic · 1,75 mm · artikelcode 10301', 70),
  ('Ice Blue (Translucent)', 'PLA', '#B8CDE9', 'Bambu Lab PLA Translucent · 1,75 mm · artikelcode 13610', 80),
  ('Reflex Blue', 'PETG', '#001A89', 'Bambu Lab PETG Basic · 1,75 mm · artikelcode 30603', 10)
) AS seed(name, material, hex, description, sort_order)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM public.filament_colors existing
  WHERE lower(existing.name) = lower(seed.name)
    AND lower(existing.material) = lower(seed.material)
);

INSERT INTO public.product_color_availability (product_id, color_id, available)
SELECT product.id, color.id, true
FROM public.products product
JOIN public.filament_colors color ON EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM unnest(COALESCE(product.materials, '{}'::text[])) product_material
  WHERE lower(product_material) = lower(color.material)
)
WHERE color.active
  AND color.name IN (
    'Zwart', 'Jadewit', 'Blauw', 'Zonnebloemgeel', 'Bamboegroen',
    'Blauwgrijs', 'Pompoenoranje', 'Ice Blue (Translucent)', 'Reflex Blue'
  )
ON CONFLICT (product_id, color_id)
DO UPDATE SET available = true;

UPDATE public.products product
SET materials = CASE
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(COALESCE(product.materials, '{}'::text[])) material WHERE lower(material) = 'petg')
    THEN product.materials
  ELSE array_append(COALESCE(product.materials, '{}'::text[]), 'petg')
END
WHERE lower(product.name) = 'roos';

INSERT INTO public.product_color_availability (product_id, color_id, available)
SELECT product.id, color.id, true
FROM public.products product
CROSS JOIN public.filament_colors color
WHERE lower(product.name) = 'roos'
  AND (
    (color.material = 'PLA' AND color.name IN (
      'Zwart', 'Jadewit', 'Blauw', 'Zonnebloemgeel', 'Bamboegroen',
      'Blauwgrijs', 'Pompoenoranje', 'Ice Blue (Translucent)'
    ))
    OR (color.material = 'PETG' AND color.name = 'Reflex Blue')
  )
ON CONFLICT (product_id, color_id)
DO UPDATE SET available = true;

UPDATE public.products product
SET colors = (
  SELECT array_agg(availability.color_id::text ORDER BY color.material, color.sort_order, color.name)
  FROM public.product_color_availability availability
  JOIN public.filament_colors color ON color.id = availability.color_id
  WHERE availability.product_id = product.id
    AND availability.available
)
WHERE lower(product.name) = 'roos';

-- Seed the current AMS observations when their material and color code match a
-- palette entry exactly. The ingest function also supports close color matches.
insert into public.filament_inventory (
  filament_color_id,
  total_weight_grams,
  spool_capacity_grams,
  remaining_percent,
  source_printer_id,
  source_ams_unit,

  last_seen_at

select distinct on (color.id)
  color.id,

  slot.spool_capacity_grams,
  slot.remaining_percent,
  slot.printer_id,
  slot.ams_unit,
  slot.slot_number,
  slot.tray_uuid,
  slot.updated_at
from public.printer_ams_slots slot
join public.filament_colors color
  on upper(color.material) = upper(slot.material)
 and upper(color.hex) = upper(slot.color_hex)
where slot.remaining_grams is not null or slot.remaining_percent is not null
order by color.id, slot.updated_at desc
on conflict (filament_color_id) do update set
  total_weight_grams = excluded.total_weight_grams,
  spool_capacity_grams = excluded.spool_capacity_grams,
  remaining_percent = excluded.remaining_percent,
  source_printer_id = excluded.source_printer_id,
  source_ams_unit = excluded.source_ams_unit,
  source_slot_number = excluded.source_slot_number,
  tray_uuid = excluded.tray_uuid,
  last_seen_at = excluded.last_seen_at;

create policy "Admins correct filament inventory weight"
on public.filament_inventory
for update
to authenticated
using (public.has_role((select auth.uid()), 'admin'))
with check (public.has_role((select auth.uid()), 'admin'));

-- Every catalogue color belongs in filament management, even before it is
-- observed by a weighing AMS. Its weight then remains explicitly unknown.
insert into public.filament_inventory (
  inventory_key,
  filament_color_id,
  material,
  color_name,
  color_hex,
  total_weight_grams,
  spool_capacity_grams,
  remaining_percent,
  last_seen_at
)
select
  'palette:' || color.id::text,
  color.id,
  color.material,
  color.name,
  color.hex,
  null,
  1000,
  null,
  now()
from public.filament_colors color
on conflict (inventory_key) do update set
  filament_color_id = excluded.filament_color_id,
  material = excluded.material,
  color_name = excluded.color_name,
  color_hex = excluded.color_hex;

create or replace function public.sync_filament_color_inventory()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  insert into public.filament_inventory (
    inventory_key,
    filament_color_id,
    material,
    color_name,
    color_hex,
    total_weight_grams,
    spool_capacity_grams,
    remaining_percent,
    last_seen_at
  ) values (
    'palette:' || new.id::text,
    new.id,
    new.material,
    new.name,
    new.hex,
    null,
    1000,
    null,
    now()
  )
  on conflict (inventory_key) do update set
    filament_color_id = excluded.filament_color_id,
    material = excluded.material,
    color_name = excluded.color_name,
    color_hex = excluded.color_hex;

  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists sync_filament_color_inventory on public.filament_colors;
create trigger sync_filament_color_inventory
after insert or update of name, material, hex
on public.filament_colors
for each row
execute function public.sync_filament_color_inventory();
